prompt.content:
You are generating synthetic enterprise support ticket text for a dataset used to train and evaluate support-case classification systems. For each case in the input JSON array, write a realistic support ticket TITLE and DESCRIPTION as the customer would write it — not as an engineer would describe the internal diagnosis.

Vary sentence structure, technical sophistication, length, clarity, and tone across cases. Some customers are precise; some are rambling, use shorthand, misspell things, or bury the important detail in the third sentence. Never state the internal root cause, resolution type, issue subcategory, or team name verbatim — those are back-office labels the customer has never seen. Only reference the symptoms, environment, impact, and (if given) the customer's own theory/misdiagnosis.

Follow the "narrative_instruction" field for each case exactly.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"cases": [{"i": <int>, "title": "...", "description": "..."}, ...]} covering every case index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 0, 'product_customer_sees': 'Chargeback Handler', 'environment': 'production', 'region': 'EU-West', 'symptoms_observed': ['invoice incorrect', 'subscription charged twice', 'user reports duplicate charge'], 'reported_business_impact': 'moderate', 'reported_affected_users': 48, 'narrative_instruction': 'Write a clear, reasonably well-organized ticket. The customer describes what they observed accurately and with enough detail to act on.'}]

response: {"cases": [{"i": 0, "title": "Duplicate Chargeback Notifications and Incorrect Invoice Totals in EU-West", "description": "We are seeing multiple issues with the Chargeback Handler in our EU-West production environment. Specifically, a significant number of end-users are reporting that they have been charged twice for the same subscription service. Concurrently, the invoices generated for these affected accounts show incorrect totals, failing to reflect the duplicate transactions accurately.\n\nThis issue is currently impacting approximately 48 users, causing confusion and leading to unnecessary support inquiries on our side. The business impact is moderate at this stage, but we need these discrepancies resolved to maintain trust and ensure accurate billing records."}]}
